## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4004. The issue was that notification-worker was trying to reach `smtp-relay` using a short service name that only works within the same namespace. After the smtp-relay Service was moved to the shared-infra namespace, the DNS lookups started failing. The fix is to update the `SMTP_HOST` configuration to use the fully qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra`, which will allow cross-namespace service discovery to work correctly.
